plot_events: A glowing humanoid figure cries out as its body is overwhelmed by a concentrated blue-white energy impact.
The impact expands into a large explosive flash in space.
The scene transitions to a red interior or organic-looking zone filled with elongated spike-like structures closing in around a small figure.
The central figure appears surrounded or pinned at the center of the converging structures.
A speaker warns that they are linked to countless others and that killing them would cause a chain reaction destroying their whole universe.
Another speaker rejects or overrides the warning, declaring that the target's time has come.
uncertainties: The exact identities of the speakers and the glowing central figure are not given on this page.

Some dialogue is small and partially difficult to read, so wording may not be exact.

visual_summary: A luminous, partially mechanical-looking humanoid form is struck or pierced by intense energy in space. The top panels show its body flaring with blue-white light and a violent burst. The lower sequence shifts to a red, organic-looking environment where long spike-like forms converge around a small glowing figure. A final side panel shows a small distant figure beside a large dark vertical mass while a speech balloon warns that destroying the speaker would trigger catastrophic consequences.
